Ion Stoica is a Romanian-American computer scientist and the co-founder of the cloud computing company Databricks. He is known for his contributions to the field of distributed systems and has made significant contributions to the development of Apache Hadoop, a popular open-source framework for distributed storage and processing of large datasets.

Stoica is also a professor at the University of California, Berkeley, where he holds the position of the Chief Scientist of the Berkeley Data Lab. He has received numerous awards and honors for his work, including the ACM SIGOPS Lifetime Achievement Award and the ACM SIGMOD Edgar F. Codd Innovations Award.

His work has been instrumental in advancing the technology behind big data processing and distributed computing systems, which are crucial for handling and analyzing large volumes of data.
